description: Header file defining the ARTPAssembler class and related structures for RTP packet assembly in Android's media framework.

classes.name: ARTPAssembler
classes.description: Abstract class for assembling RTP packets, providing utility functions and interface for packet processing.

classes.name: ReceptionReportBlock
classes.description: Structure representing an RTCP reception report block with metrics about packet loss and jitter.

methods.name: onPacketReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming RTP packets from a source.

methods.name: onByeReceived
methods.description: Virtual method called when a BYE RTCP packet is received.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the assembler is initialized properly.

methods.name: MsToRtp
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to RTP timestamp units.

methods.name: RtpToMs
methods.description: Converts RTP timestamp units to milliseconds.
